title: Beyond the 956: Frankie Muniz hospitalized after Daytona practice crash
excerpt: Actor and NASCAR driver Frankie Muniz was taken to a hospital after crashing during a practice lap at Daytona International Speedway on Wednesday, Nov. 11. He is awake and alert, according to Ford and Team Reaume.
content:
Frankie Muniz, the 40-year-old actor known for Malcolm in the Middle and now a NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series driver, was hospitalized Wednesday, Nov. 11, after crashing during a practice lap at Daytona International Speedway in Florida.

Muniz was preparing for Ford's “Proud to Honor Veterans Day Classic,” where he was set to race for Team Air Force. The crash happened while the venue was closed to the public.

Ford and Team Reaume, the team Muniz drives for in the Truck Series, said in a statement that Muniz “was taken to a local medical facility for further evaluation and is awake and alert.”

The extent of his injuries has not been disclosed, and what caused the crash has not been released. Muniz will not compete in Wednesday evening's exhibition race.

Sources: E! News, USA TODAY, Entertainment Tonight, Ford / Team Reaume statement.
